# AllSkills

> > Curated directory of 500+ Claude AI skills from Anthropic, featuring ready-to-use prompt templates for development, design, writing, security, and automation workflows.

AllSkills is a comprehensive catalog of Claude Code skills across 8 categories, offering both a browsable directory and tools like the Skill Generator to help users discover, copy, and create custom AI skills. The platform supports multiple languages (English, Chinese, German) and provides tutorials on skill development, MCP server building, and integration with tools like Composio for workflow automation.

## Key Topics

- Claude AI & Claude Code
- Anthropic Skills Library
- Prompt Engineering & Templates
- Skill Development (YAML/Markdown)
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- Workflow Automation & Composio
- Python Development & Package Management
- Smart Contract Security (Trail of Bits, Slither)
- Frontend Design & React
- Internal Communications Templates
- API Design & Backend Patterns
- Scientific Writing & IMRAD
- Marketing Copy & SEO Tools
- Obsidian Markdown Syntax
- GitHub Actions CI/CD

## Core Directory & Tools

- [AllSkills Homepage (English)](https://allskills.cn/en): Main directory: Discover, browse & create 500+ Claude Skills across 8 categories
- [AllSkills Homepage (Chinese)](https://allskills.cn): 中文主页：发现、浏览与创建 500+ Claude Skills
- [AllSkills Homepage (German)](https://allskills.cn/de): Deutsche Startseite: 500+ Anthropic Skills entdecken und durchsuchen
- [Skills Directory (English)](https://allskills.cn/en/skills): Full catalog: 500+ Claude AI skills for design, dev, writing - search & copy
- [Skills Directory (Chinese)](https://allskills.cn/skills): 完整目录：500+ AI 技能一键复制
- [Browse by Category](https://allskills.cn/en/collections): Browse 500+ Claude AI skills across 8 categories (Design, Dev, Writing, etc.)
- [Trending Skills](https://allskills.cn/en/trending): Real-time trending skills: AI SDK, Python optimization, RAG, API design
- [Skill Generator Tool](https://allskills.cn/tools/skill-generator): Free AI tool to generate Claude Code SKILL.md files from descriptions

## Skill Development Guides

- [Skill Creator Guide](https://allskills.cn/en/skills/skill-creator): Guide for creating effective Claude skills with YAML/Markdown structure
- [Claude Code Skill Development](https://allskills.cn/en/skills/claude-code-skill-development): Claude Code plugin skill development: structure, progressive disclosure, YAML
- [Writing Skills (TDD Approach)](https://allskills.cn/en/skills/superpowers-writing-skills): TDD approach to skill creation: test-driven documentation for Claude/Codex
- [Dify Skill Creator](https://allskills.cn/en/skills/dify-skill-creator): Dify-specific skill creator guide with progressive disclosure patterns
- [MCP Server Builder](https://allskills.cn/en/skills/mcp-builder): MCP server development guide: FastMCP (Python) & MCP SDK (TypeScript)
- [Quick Start Tutorial](https://allskills.cn/en/blog/skill-usage-quickstart): Beginner guide: 3 steps to copy, paste & use Claude Skills effectively

- [UV Package Manager](https://allskills.cn/en/skills/agents-uv-package-manager): UV package manager (Rust-based): fast Python dependency management & virtualenvs
